arabic: حَاسِبُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُحَاسَبُوا، وَزِنُوا أَعْمَالَكُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُوزَنُوا

translations.en: Take account of yourselves before you are called to account, and weigh your deeds before they are weighed.
The worth of every person is in what they do well.

arabic: لَا تَكُنْ عَبْدَ غَيْرِكَ وَقَدْ جَعَلَكَ اللَّهُ حُرًّا

translations.en: Do not be a slave to others, for Allah has created you free.

arabic: الْوَقْتُ كَالسَّيْفِ، إِنْ لَمْ تَقْطَعْهُ قَطَعَكَ

translations.en: Time is like a sword: if you do not cut it, it cuts you.

arabic: الْعِلْمُ مَا نَفَعَ، لَيْسَ الْعِلْمُ مَا حُفِظَ

translations.en: Knowledge is what benefits; it is not merely what is memorized.

arabic: ابْنَ آدَمَ، إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ أَيَّامٌ، كُلَّمَا ذَهَبَ يَوْمٌ ذَهَبَ بَعْضُكَ

translations.en: O son of Adam, you are but days; whenever a day passes, a part of you passes away.

arabic: النَّاسُ إِلَى الْعِلْمِ أَحْوَجُ مِنْهُمْ إِلَى الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ

translations.en: People are in greater need of knowledge than of food and drink.

arabic: مَنْ أَرَادَ السَّعَادَةَ الْأَبَدِيَّةَ فَلْيَلْزَمْ عَتَبَةَ الْعُبُودِيَّةِ

translations.en: Whoever desires everlasting happiness, let him cling to the threshold of servitude to Allah.

arabic: الْعِلْمُ بِلَا عَمَلٍ جُنُونٌ، وَالْعَمَلُ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ لَا يَكُونُ

translations.en: Knowledge without action is madness, and action without knowledge cannot be.

arabic: مَنْ شَكَرَ اللَّهَ وَلَمْ يَشْكُرْ وَالِدَيْهِ لَمْ يُقْبَلْ مِنْهُ

translations.en: Whoever is grateful to Allah but not to his parents — it will not be accepted from him.

reference: Abdullah ibn Umar (RA), to a man who carried his mother in tawaf
arabic: مَا جَزَيْتَهَا، وَلَا بِزَفْرَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْ زَفَرَاتِهَا

translations.en: You have not repaid her - not even for a single one of her labour pains.
